title: When Disagreement Labels Do Not Identify F1 Rankings: reproducibility artifact
description: Reproducibility artifact for When Disagreement Labels Do Not Identify F1 Rankings. V5 manuscript positions the explicit F1 audit against Kuboyama, Musgrove, Okanovic, TDC and Polo; correct benchmark attribution and final Lipton reference. Scientific code, frozen predictions, results, figure and protocols remain unchanged. Prepared for ESANN 2027; not submitted or accepted. Version-specific DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23647323. Software BSD-3-Clause, manuscript CC BY 4.0, original template license retained.
